mentions.name: SNES cloud save sync bridge
mentions.description: This project enables cloud save syncing between a real Super Nintendo console and emulators. A spare controller port is wired to a microcontroller that acts as a WiFi bridge, and on a flash cart the reset vector is patched to a small save sync routine that talks to the microcontroller.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Cloud save sync between a real Super Nintendo and emulators.

I’ve just got back into hobby electronics after a fifteen year diversion into software. I set up my workbench this week and this is my first project, something I first imagined building twenty years ago!

I spent the weekend wiring the spare controller port to a microcontroller to act as WiFi bridge. I have a flash cart, so I patch the reset vector to a small save sync routine that talks to the microcontroller.
